intro.abigail: Oh, you play Valley Triad? It's the best pastime in the Saloon! Here, take a starter deck — challenge folks here on Fridays and win their cards.
challenge.question: Play a round of Valley Triad with {{name}}?
hud.starter: You received a Valley Triad starter deck!
hud.builddeck: Build a 5-card deck first (Valley Triad menu).
tut.intro1: Each card has four numbers: top, right, bottom and left. That's the card's strength on each side.
tut.intro2: Place a card next to an enemy card — if your touching number is HIGHER, you capture it! Whoever owns the most cards at the end wins.
tut.opp1: I'll go first, right in the middle. Watch closely!
tut.hint.capture: Play the Pumpkin below Abigail's card — its top 6 beats her bottom 4.
tut.captured: See? Your 6 beat my 4, so my card flipped to your color. That's a capture!
tut.hint.elemental: That green tile is a Spring tile. Play the Cauliflower there — Spring cards get +1 on every side!
tut.elemental: Nice! On a season tile, matching cards get +1 on all sides — but everything else gets -1. Watch where you place!
tut.hint.same: Now play the Potato on the top-right: BOTH touching numbers are equal (2 = 2 and 3 = 3)...
tut.same: SAME! When two or more touching numbers tie, you capture ALL of those cards at once. Devastating!
tut.hint.block: One last tip: block the bottom-left corner with the Parsnip so I can't sneak a capture there.
tut.end: That's it! The board is full — most cards wins, and you got me this time. Challenge me for real on Fridays at the Saloon!
tut.done.hud: Tutorial complete! Challenge villagers on Fridays at the Saloon.
